open_points: No safety assurance, safe-state allocation or error-return contract is assessed or invented. Caller-owned access setup and the invocation domain are part of this prospective development scope.

requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the CRC LL driver shall not write any CRC register.
requirements.verification: Target startup observation passes when no driver write occurs before an explicit IDR call.

requirements.statement: When either scoped IDR function is invoked with a valid accessible CRC instance, the CRC LL driver shall complete without polling a status flag.
requirements.verification: Source/control-flow review and bounded host/target execution pass when the IDR functions contain no status-polling loop.

open_points: Caller must provide a valid accessible CRC instance. This slice specifies no behavior for invalid pointers or inaccessible hardware.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes write-IDR with a value and a valid accessible CRC instance, the CRC LL driver shall write the supplied 32-bit value to CRC_IDR.IDR.
requirements.verification: Host and target tests pass when zero, all ones and alternating values reach all 32 CRC_IDR.IDR bits without changing unrelated registers.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes read-IDR with a valid accessible CRC instance, the CRC LL driver shall return the current 32-bit value of CRC_IDR.IDR.
requirements.verification: Independent read tests preset IDR without the write API and pass when all 32 bits are returned and no register changes.

origin.basis: Same functional IDR payload; add owner-selected simulation-only CPU/timing development targets.
